description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Cor], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Fire abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical) V2], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Physical Ability Instant Cast (15s)] to all allies if there are at least 4 Samurai/FFXV allies in the party, otherwise grants [Fire Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Fire 142% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Fire attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical) V2
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Fire ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Physical Ability Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Cast speed x999999 for Physical abilities

description.name: Fire Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Fire 142% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [142% ATB 1] after using a Fire ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 142% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.42
